GeneratedMiniHero.label: Generated Mini Hero
GeneratedMiniHero.styles: .generated-mini-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem); align-items: center; padding: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem) clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7f0e6 0%, #fffdf9 100%); color: #1e2521; } .generated-mini-hero__media { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 37, 33, 0.12); background: #e9dfd1; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(30, 37, 33, 0.08); } .generated-mini-hero__image { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 320px; } .generated-mini-hero__image > div { margin: 0 auto; } .generated-mini-hero__content { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; align-items: flex-start; } .generated-mini-hero__title { margin: 0; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5.25rem); line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.06em; } .generated-mini-hero__description { max-width: 40rem; color: #55615b; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; } .generated-mini-hero__description p { margin: 0; } .generated-mini-hero__ctas { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; } .generated-mini-hero__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .generated-mini-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .generated-mini-hero__image { min-height: 240px; } }
